observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/verify_final.sh <<'EOF'
set -e
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
C() { docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve "$1:443:$CADDY_IP" "${@:2}"; }
printf 'frontend  https://app.localhost/login           -> %s\n' "$(C app.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.localhost/login)"
printf 'api       https://api.localhost/api/v1/         -> %s\n' "$(C api.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/)"
printf 'api doc   https://api.localhost/api/v1/schema/  -> %s\n' "$(C api.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/schema/)"
printf 'admin     https://admin.localhost/admin/login/  -> %s\n' "$(C admin.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://admin.localhost/admin/login/)"
printf 'tiles     https://tiles.localhost/health        -> %s\n' "$(C tiles.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://tiles.localhost/health)"
printf 'qgis auth https://api.localhost/.../qgis-auth/  -> %s\n' "$(C api.localhost -u admin:AdminLocalPassw0rd! -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/qgis-auth/)"
printf 'webdav    https://files.localhost/              -> %s (401=auth required)\n' "$(C files.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://files.localhost/)"
EOF
bash /tmp/verify_final.sh; echo "=== container count running ==="; docker ps --filter name=qonnectra --format '{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}' | wc -l
